facts.text: Kbely Airport was the first Czechoslovak military airfield, hosting major public air shows during the inter‑war period.
Between 1918 and 1937, Kbely served commercial aviation and was the home base of Czechoslovak Airline (ČLS) and Czechoslovak Airlines (ČSA).
The first scheduled flight by Czechoslovak Airlines left Kbely for Bratislava in October 1923.
Prague’s charm lies in its walkable historic centre, riverside views, classical music tradition and relaxed café culture.
The Prague Visitor Pass is the only official city card that lets you visit unique historical monuments, museums, and galleries.
Prague offers an educational program for residents and visitors called Pražské vlastivědy, Zažij Prahu, and Pražské univerzity pro každého.
